edition: IPC-2152 (2009) Table 3-1 - closed-form fit by Brooks & Adam (2015)
note: IPC-2152 itself publishes charts, not equations (KiCad's own header says so). What is stored here is therefore not a transcription of chart pixels but the published closed-form fit to that data, with the coefficients copied verbatim from KiCad 10.0 (common/track_width_calculations.cpp), which is the second independent implementation. Every coefficient below is readable in public source, so it can be checked instead of trusted.

model.internal_selection_rule: nearest nominal copper weight by supplied thickness; the switch points are the midpoints (0.689+1.378)/2, (1.378+2.756)/2, (2.756+4.134)/2 (KiCad coefficients())

sources.role: independent implementation whose coefficients are copied verbatim

sources.id: D. G. Brooks and J. Adam, "Trace Currents and Temperatures Revisited" (2015), fit to IPC-2152 Table 3-1
sources.role: the fit itself; named as the origin in KiCad's header

model_limits: chart fit: it reproduces the published data, it is not the data
no board thickness, no adjacent copper, no airflow, no mask opening - those are the IPC-2152 parameters the fit drops
external uses one fit for all copper weights; internal fits are picked in 4 discrete buckets, so internal answers can jump at a bucket edge

anchors.note: vs IPC-2221 same question = 11.826 mil: 2152 is less conservative outside
narrower than external - the 2x internal derating of IPC-2221 is not in 2152
current-from-width direction; IPC-2221 gives 13.183 degC for the same trace

anchor_meaning: Anchors are produced by this repo's own solver from the coefficients above, so they catch implementation drift (wrong exponent, wrong bucket, mil/mm slip) - they do NOT validate the fit against the physical standard. The fit's own uncertainty is stated in model_limits and in every answer's precision field.
points_note: Empty on purpose: points were meant for a digitised chart transcription, which is why this file used to refuse to be filled. The closed-form model above replaced that plan, so the row schema stays supported for anyone who does have a properly attributed transcription.

why_empty.rule: a digitised guess is not a table
why_empty.what_was_looked_for: IPC-2152 numeric tables (current vs cross-section, per copper weight and allowed temperature rise)
why_empty.what_was_found: plot images and screenshots only; no numeric transcription with a stated table/figure id and edition
why_empty.what_replaced_it: the published closed-form fit to IPC-2152 Table 3-1 (Brooks & Adam 2015), coefficients taken verbatim from KiCad 10.0 open source - checkable instead of trusted
what_is_still_missing: board thickness / adjacent copper / airflow dependence - dropped by the fit
any statement about plated through holes; IPC-2152 does not describe them
the standard's own charts, which are not redistributed
